form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: Handwritten form on a faint, skewed photocopy scan - all summary figures are medium confidence. OFFICE NOT STATED: the Office cell on the cover page is genuinely EMPTY (verified at high zoom - the county's black redaction bar covers only the Address/City/State/Zip row above it, not the Office cell), so office_printed is '' and index.csv's blank office is NOT resolved by this filing. Street address and city are redacted upstream by the county (black bar), so residence_city is ''; the signature is likewise blacked out but the Date box (4-2-22) and the 'Date of Report' box (4-2-22) survive. Box A is written '$0'. The close balance reads $985.62 on a degraded scan (medium confidence); this is consistent with the form's own printed 'Box F - Box D' relation, offered here only as corroboration - the figure was READ, not computed. Corroborating the D box, the Schedule B page (p9) prints 'Total Expenditures Made $ 2,723.47'. PAGE-FACE vs LOCATOR: the locator flagged p9 as a second COVER page, but p9 is a Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made continuation sheet, and p13 is the county's internal CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST (staff-reviewed 4/4/22). This 14-page PDF therefore contains ONE report, not two.

itemized.notes: HEIDI BALDERREE, 2022, modern_boxAF rev 'v. 4.20', ENTIRELY HANDWRITTEN and retained as a FAINT, SKEWED PHOTOCOPY with a red scanner border bled onto every sheet - the hardest document in this chunk to measure and the one that needed the --col recovery on all four schedule pages. FOURTEEN pages, every one read full-page and classified from its own printed header: p1 cover; p3 and p5 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received'; p7 and p9 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made'; p11 'Summary Page'; p13 the CHECKLIST DECOY; and pp2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 and 14 ALL GENUINELY BLANK - the document was scanned duplex from single-sided sheets, so every report page is followed by an empty verso. That is a page-count property worth knowing: a 14-page PDF here is a 7-page filing. THE CHECKLIST DECOY IS BOUND IN AT p13 - 'CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST' with the Website/Network/HOLD box, reciting every summary-page label ('Balance at Beginning of Period', 'Contributions Received this Period', '... Year to Date', 'Expenditures Made this Period', '... Year to Date', 'Subtotal before Expenditures', 'Positive balance at Close of Reporting Period') and carrying ZERO dollar figures, printed TWICE on one sheet with two staff review copies (Staff Signature #1 in red dated 4/4/22, Staff Signature #2 in purple dated 4/4/2022). NOTE IT IS BORN-DIGITAL CLEAN while every report page is a degraded photocopy - the checklist was added by the office after the filing was received, which is itself a tell that it is a clerk work product and not a report page. THE SUMMARY PAGE IS p11, NOT THE LAST PAGE OF THE PDF - located by content, exactly as the standing rule requires. OFFICE IS GENUINELY UNSTATED: the cover's Office cell is EMPTY (the county's redaction bar covers the Address row above it and stops short of the Office cell, which is simply blank), and index.csv carries a blank office for this filing. Nothing was inferred - not from the form's title, not from the filing address. Page-face candidate 'Heidi Balderree' agrees with the channel label. Report type: 'Seven days preceding Convention' is the filled radio; the amendment question is answered No; the signature block is BLACKED OUT BY THE COUNTY while the Date box beside it reads 4-2-22, matching the Date of Report boxes on every sheet. TWO INKS ARE AT WORK ON SCHEDULE A SHEET 1 and it matters: the filer's entries are black, and a BLUE/PURPLE hand adds a city to row 1's address cell, obliterates a word in row 13's address cell, and obliterates the day digit of row 14's date. Where the blue ADDS a legible value it is carried at low confidence with the second ink recorded; where it OBLITERATES, nothing is guessed - row 13 keeps only the black 'Lehi' the cell itself prints, and row 14's date is left BLANK with needs_review. The same discipline is applied on Schedule B, where a struck-through amount on sheet 1 row 4 is replaced by a handwritten '345.39' - the correction governs and the closure confirms it, and the struck figure is not reconstructed. PRIVACY: this filing is heavily redacted upstream - a black bar over the street line in most address cells - and the city/state/zip line below each bar is published in the clear. Every row's city/state comes from that visible line; no street line reached this record, and where a cell carries only a zip nothing was converted into a city name. The candidate's own address on the cover is blacked out by the county; her phone and email are published in the clear and were deliberately not carried. A SOURCE PROPERTY WORTH RECORDING: Schedule B sheet 2 is ELEVEN CONSECUTIVE WinRed payment-processor fee rows, each tying its fee to a named contribution by the DONOR'S INITIALS in the purpose cell ('Processing Fee  M.O.'). It is the first filing in this corpus to itemize per-contribution processing fees, and the initials are the filer's own cross-reference between the two schedules; they are transcribed verbatim as part of the purpose and were NOT used to fill any field on the other side. Columns were assigned by CONTENT as well as position (field-shift screen): no inversion on any sheet. All six row-index traps screened on all four sheets: the first written entry is band 1 everywhere (crop-proved), no continuation line, no voided row, no banner line, nothing below the last printed rule (crop-proved on the two FULL sheets, p3 and p7), and no doubled band - every recovered grid is regular-pitch and every sheet closes to the cent.
